Codex CLI 0.169.0 installed locally. Now configure it for obscurify.


Need to check codex config format for 0.169 — uses config.toml with model_providers. Let me write it and test a trivial exec.

Pick a fresh obscurify key. Let me take one with $1 and few requests — e.g. account 7363665256943670 (5 requests). Get its key from ob_accounts.txt line... but keys are masked in output; I need to write to env/file without printing.

Approach: extract key from file into a env file, then export in command. Don't print.

Let me create ~/.obscurify_key file with the key (mode 600) via python reading ob_accounts.txt and matching account number.

Then test codex exec with a trivial prompt.

Let me write config + key, then test.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PY'
import os,re
acc="7363665256943670"
key=None
for l in open("ob_accounts.txt"):
    p=[x.strip() for x in l.split("|")]
    if p and p[0]==acc and p[1].startswith("sk-obs1"): key=p[1]
assert key, "key tidak ketemu"
p=os.path.expanduser("~/.obscurify_key")
open(p,"w").write(key)
os.chmod(p,0o600)
print("key disimpan di",p,"panjang",len(key))
PY
mkdir -p ~/.codex && cat > ~/.codex/config.toml <<'EOF'
model = "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored"
model_provider = "obscurify"

[model_providers.obscurify]
name = "obscurify"
base_url = "https://obscurify.ai/v1"
env_key = "OBSCURIFY_API_KEY"
wire_api = "chat"
EOF
cat ~/.codex/config.toml
